commit.message:
wp1334: chuoi realpath tinh tu duong goc, khong tu ban da abspath

Review PR #1367 (comment 4597850151): _trong_kho_git goi abspath truoc
realpath nen `..` dung sau symlink bi gop theo tu vung. Voi
<ngoai>/lk/../codexhome (lk -> <kho>/con) chot tra None trong khi kernel
ghi vao <kho>/codexhome. Tai lap tren 8ed3503: auth.json va tep dau deu
lot vao kho.

- scripts/tl_gws.py: hai chuoi la abspath(path) va realpath(path).
- ops/cloud_agent_creds_test.py: ca pd8 (bon bien the + ve duong ngoai
  kho), dot bien PD8_realpath_sau_abspath.
- RELEASE_MANIFEST.json tai sinh.

Bo test: 60/60, 91/91. selftest 1777/1777.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_015GtxrZ6bCzNXoqjwqyrJTq
